action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 coverage of all legal root moves to identify best candidates after Black's Rg7.
action.rationale: No prior analyses survived; broad search required. Black's rook on g7 attacks our queen on h7, so it must move. Queen is somewhat trapped (g7 rook, f7 king, e7 bishop cover escapes); options include Qh8, Qh6, Qxg7+ and Qg6+. Need full root coverage to find best.
